title: Private Personnel Session; No Public Action
summary:
*   A special meeting was convened primarily for a closed-door executive session to discuss specific personnel matters.
*   All substantive discussions on these personnel issues occurred privately, as authorized by Texas state law.
*   Following the confidential session, the council made no public actions, cast no votes, and announced no policy decisions.
